crossRefs.note: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able…
They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of…
After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am…
My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look, and fail with longing for them all…
But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”
My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids.
I chattered like a swallow or a crane. I moaned like a dove. My eyes weaken looking upward. Lord, I am oppressed. Be my…
My eyes fail with tears. My heart is troubled. My liver is poured on the earth, because of the destruction of the…
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

translations.web: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.
translations.bsb: I am weary from my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
translations.kjv: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
translations.asv: I am weary with my crying; my throat is dried: Mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
